author: blu
body: Pre-game sequence: dice roll (or coin flip) to determine who goes first, deck shuffling, mulligan procedure (London mulligan), and opening hand draw. This module drives the full setup from two decklists to a ready-to-play GameState.

author: blu
body: A hand is kept when it has a workable amount of mana -- two to five mana sources out of seven, counting lands and mana artifacts (a hand with a Mox and a Sol Ring keeps on one land). A no-land or all-land hand is mulliganed: the hand goes back, the library is reshuffled, and a fresh seven is drawn (the London mulligan), up to three times. On the keep, one card is put on the bottom per mulligan taken, shedding the most redundant type -- excess mana when the hand is flooded, a spell when it is not. This is what stops a game being decided by a screwed or flooded opening seven.
